confirmed_defect.cause: The original decision future owns CloseOnDrop for the real successor slot. The draft direct select dropped that future when Training won, permanently closing the slot. It was incorrect to call both losing reads harmless.

correction: Construct exactly one original decision future in a lexical scope before select, pin in Box, borrow its Pin via as_mut for select. A Training win retains the same future throughout actual B evidence acquisition/installation and awaits that same future. It is never recreated, repolled after completion or retried. The completed future is dropped at scope exit before later handoff move.
preserved: Every actual owner check, B data/command, original installer and error propagation
NoUpdate skips B and cancels only the read-only Training notice
Any error/cancellation drops the preserved decision future and closes the original slot; outer common Gate cleanup remains
All Artifact/Selection/CURRENT/FinalUse/C/Outcome source outside the one block unchanged
